# Vendoring manifest — superseded

This file was the vendoring manifest for the msdf-atlas-gen / msdfgen
vendoring work (APX-217). Its content has been folded into
[`README.md`](./README.md), which is now the single authoritative document
for the vendored library (provenance, licenses, build options, C API usage,
ownership rules, and verification). See:

- Upstream pins, trimming, and provenance: `README.md` §2
- Dependencies and licenses: `README.md` §3
- CMake targets and build options: `README.md` §4
- C API usage and rules: `README.md` §5–§6
- Engine integration scope: `README.md` §7

Full historical detail (including the original survey of the legacy C++
`main` branch and corrections found while wiring the v2 build) is preserved
in git history.
